Contrast is the WCAG ratio of the token against `paper`. Text tokens should stay at or above 4.5; surface tokens (`background`, `panel`, `paper`, `active`, `line`) are not text colours.

### Fonts

| Token | Value | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `UI_FONT` | `.SystemUIFont` (SF Pro on macOS) | Chrome, labels, chat and reading prose |
| `MONO_FONT` | `Menlo` | Paths, UUIDs, model ids, byte ranges, counts, Markdown editors |
